title: 第1课 · 九月去北京旅游最好
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 1 — 九月去北京旅游最好 · September is the best time to visit Beijing

data.topic: 课上要点 · Class notes (Lesson 1)

items.zh: 总览 · What this class was about
items.en: Warm-up and review (numbers, 吃了吗, time, jobs and retirement, what you did last week, comparing temperatures), then Lesson 1 九月去北京旅游最好: why September is the best time for Beijing, when to visit the Netherlands, the new words with their radicals (猫, 眼睛), and a long list of sports. Each topic has a short explanation and example sentences; the practice tabs hold the same material for flashcards, quiz and fill-in. A second class on Lesson 1 practised ordering coffee, the difference between 要 and 想, the measure word 把 and the text 九月去北京旅游最好, ending with group discussions. The groups then presented their favourite sport and the best time to travel, and we read a short text about surfing for the first time.
晚点 is for schedules — a plane or train is delayed. 迟到 is for people — you arrive late for class or work.
see: 练习 · Practice (Warm-up questions)

items.zh: 从东京来的飞机到了吗？——不知道，晚点了。
items.py: Cóng Dōngjīng lái de fēijī dàole ma? — Bù zhīdào, wǎndiǎn le.
items.en: Has the plane from Tokyo arrived? — I don't know, it's delayed.
Telling the time: 一点 = 1:00, 一点五分 = 1:05, 一点八分 = 1:08. Careful: 一点 also means 'a little' (快一点 = a bit faster, 少一点儿 = a bit less).
see: 练习 · Practice (Warm-up questions)

items.zh: 3 · 七八岁 vs 七十八岁 · 退休
items.en: 七八岁 = about seven or eight (an estimate, Lesson 1 grammar); 七十八岁 = 78. Retirement (退休): in the Netherlands around 67–68; in China women traditionally at 55, men at 60.
see: 练习 · Practice (Warm-up questions)
文化 · Culture (中荷差异 China vs Netherlands)

items.zh: 你妈妈做什么工作？——她退休了。
items.py: Nǐ māma zuò shénme gōngzuò? — Tā tuìxiū le.
items.en: What does your mother do? — She's retired.

items.zh: 在荷兰，六十七、六十八岁退休。
items.py: Zài Hélán, liùshíqī, liùshíbā suì tuìxiū.
items.en: In the Netherlands people retire at 67 or 68.

items.zh: 在中国，女的五十五岁退休。
items.py: Zài Zhōngguó, nǚ de wǔshíwǔ suì tuìxiū.

items.zh: 我的外祖母七十三岁了，还在工作。
items.py: Wǒ de wàizǔmǔ qīshísān suì le, hái zài gōngzuò.
items.en: My grandmother is 73 and still working.

items.zh: 4 · 什么都没… / 哪儿都没… / 谁都不…
items.en: Question word + 都 + 没/不 = nothing / nowhere / nobody. Use 没 for the past (last week), 不 for habits or plans (this holiday, in general).
see: 练习 · Practice (什么都没 / 哪儿都没 / 谁都不)

items.zh: 你们上个星期做了什么？——我感冒了，什么都没做。
items.py: Nǐmen shàng ge xīngqī zuòle shénme? — Wǒ gǎnmào le, shénme dōu méi zuò.
items.en: What did you do last week? — I had a cold, I did nothing.

items.zh: 我上个星期哪儿都没去。
items.py: Wǒ shàng ge xīngqī nǎr dōu méi qù.
items.en: I didn't go anywhere last week.

items.py: Qiūjià wǒ nǎr dōu bú qù.
items.en: I'm not going anywhere in the autumn break.
Comparing temperatures: A 比 B 高/低 + number + 度. Don't forget the detail — how many degrees.
see: 练习 · Practice (Warm-up questions)

items.zh: 上个星期六比这个星期六高多少度？
items.py: Shàng ge xīngqīliù bǐ zhège xīngqīliù gāo duōshao dù?
items.en: How many degrees warmer was last Saturday than this Saturday?

items.zh: 上个星期六的温度比这个星期六高三度。
items.py: Shàng ge xīngqīliù de wēndù bǐ zhège xīngqīliù gāo sān dù.
items.en: Last Saturday was three degrees warmer than this Saturday.

items.zh: 6 · 九月去北京旅游最好 — why?
items.en: When you choose when to travel, think of: 天气 (weather), 价格 (price), 人多不多 (crowds) and 食物 (food). September in Beijing: not cold, not hot; not busy; cheaper tickets.
see: 课文1 · 1. 在学校 — In the school
练习 · Practice (什么时候去……最好？)

items.zh: 九月北京天气很好，不冷也不热。
items.py: Jiǔ yuè Běijīng tiānqì hěn hǎo, bù lěng yě bú rè.
items.en: In September the weather in Beijing is good — not cold, not hot.

items.zh: 九月人不多，机票更便宜。
items.py: Jiǔ yuè rén bù duō, jīpiào gèng piányi.
items.en: In September there are fewer people and flights are cheaper.
Your Chinese friend asks when to visit the Netherlands. The class said April: spring, lots of flowers, good weather, fresh fish.
see: 练习 · Practice (什么时候去……最好？)

items.zh: 你什么时候来荷兰最好？——四月。
items.py: Nǐ shénme shíhou lái Hélán zuì hǎo? — Sì yuè.
items.en: When is the best time to come to the Netherlands? — April.

items.zh: 四月是春天，有很多花，可以看花。
items.py: Sì yuè shì chūntiān, yǒu hěn duō huā, kěyǐ kàn huā.
items.en: April is spring; there are lots of flowers to see.

items.py: Hái kěyǐ chī xīnxiān de yú.
items.en: And you can eat fresh fish.

items.zh: 8 · Radicals: 犭 and 目 / 日
items.en: 猫 and 狗 have the animal radical 犭. 眼睛 has 目 (eye) on the left; 晴 (clear, 晴天) has the same right side but 日 (sun). Measure words: 两只猫, 三只狗; a pair is 一双: 一双眼睛, 一双手 (but 一只手), 一双鞋, 一双袜子.
see: 练习 · Practice (量词 只 / 双, radicals)

items.py: Tā yǒu yì shuāng piàoliang de yǎnjing.
items.en: It has a pair of beautiful eyes.
踢 is for football; 打 for ball games with hands or rackets (篮球, 排球, 乒乓球, 羽毛球, 台球); other sports have their own verb or none. The best-known Dutch footballer in China: 范佩西 (Van Persie).

items.zh: ──────── Part 2 · Second class: 点咖啡 and 要 vs 想
items.en: We listened to a coffee-shop dialogue, then compared 要 and 想 and went through the Lesson 1 pictures and Text 1.

Useful café phrases: 美式 (americano), 拿铁 (latte), 卡布奇诺 (cappuccino); 热的 / 冰的; 大杯、中杯、小杯; 加糖 (add sugar), 少糖 (less sugar); 扫码付款 (pay by scanning the QR code); 请稍等 (one moment, please); 马上好 (ready in a moment).
see: 会话 · Dialogue (点咖啡 Ordering coffee)

items.en: Hello, what can I get you?

items.py: Wǒ yào yì bēi nátiě, rè de.

items.zh: 大杯还是中杯？——中杯，谢谢。
items.py: Dà bēi háishi zhōng bēi? — Zhōng bēi, xièxie.

items.en: You can pay by scanning the QR code.

想 = would like to, thinking about it — maybe it happens, maybe not (我想去北京，什么时候去？不知道). 要 = will / going to — it's decided or happening (他要去北京，下个月去). That's why you order with 要: 我要一杯拿铁, not 我想一杯拿铁. Negative of 要 (want) is usually 不想; 不要 means 'don't want / don't'.
see: 练习 · Practice (要 vs 想)

items.en: Mark would like to go to Beijing (an idea).

items.zh: 马克要去北京，下个月去。
items.py: Mǎkè yào qù Běijīng, xià ge yuè qù.
items.en: Mark is going to Beijing next month (decided).

items.zh: 我想要一杯咖啡，但是我没钱。
items.py: Wǒ xiǎng yào yì bēi kāfēi, dànshì wǒ méi qián.
items.en: I'd like a coffee, but I have no money.

items.zh: 我明天要去阿姆斯特丹。

items.en: Chairs take the measure word 把 — things you hold by a handle (把手): 一把椅子, 一把伞. 一把 can also mean 'a handful': 一把糖.
see: 练习 · Practice (量词 只 / 双, radicals)

items.zh: 这儿有几把椅子？——一把椅子。
items.py: Zhèr yǒu jǐ bǎ yǐzi? — Yì bǎ yǐzi.
items.en: How many chairs are here? — One chair.

items.zh: 13 · 不冷也不热 · 好人一生平安
items.en: Text 1: 九月的北京天气不冷也不热 — 不 A 也不 B = neither A nor B. The teacher also taught the blessing 好人一生平安: good people stay safe all their lives.

items.py: Jiǔ yuè de Běijīng tiānqì bù lěng yě bú rè.
items.en: Beijing in September is neither cold nor hot.
Good people are safe all their lives.
1) Discuss your favourite sport (one person presents). 2) When is the best time to visit Beijing — or the Netherlands — and why? Everyone may choose differently: 我想冬天去，因为我喜欢雪.

items.en: I think winter is best for Beijing, because I like snow.
Each group presented its answers to the two group questions. Texts 3 and 4 are self-study: read them at home and bring questions to the next class.
The groups explained their favourite sport with 因为……所以……: basketball, tennis, swimming (you don't notice you sweat — 出汗), bouldering (攀岩). 和……一起 + verb = do something together with someone.

items.zh: 我很喜欢游泳，因为游泳的时候不觉得出汗。

items.py: Yùndòng duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo, hěn jiànkāng.
items.en: Sport is good for your body — very healthy.
One group chose Spain in October: the weather is good, not cold and not hot, and you can go surfing at the beach. Another chose May for the Netherlands.

items.zh: 17 · 第一次冲浪 · A short text
items.en: Four sentences about surfing for the first time: weather, a wetsuit because the water is cold, falling in, and standing for four seconds. Uses 第一次, 因为, 太……了, 总是, 最后 and 最.

items.py: Wǒ juéde chōnglàng shì zuì yǒu yìsi de yùndòng!
